independence_evidence: Self-published food zine/magazine run from a Gmail address (chickenandbreadzine@gmail.com) with a founder-editor and small team; the site describes itself as a platform 'centring people of colour' and no company or media group is involved.
qualifies_reason: Independent London food publication whose fourth print issue went on sale at the end of 2025.
what_it_is: chicken + bread is a small-format food magazine that treats cooking as culture, collecting essays, poems, interviews, recipes, photography and illustration from the African, Caribbean and Asian diasporas around a single theme per issue (Issue 4 is 'Motion', on food, memory and migration). It appears about once a year at roughly 150 x 210 mm and about 100 pages, alongside a website of recipes and features. It suits readers of food writing who want personal and cultural stories rather than restaurant coverage.

cover_candidates.notes: Pics & Ink stockist listing image; appears to be the flat front cover at 1000x1500.

uncertainties: The publisher's Wix site has a 'Get Issue 4!' banner but its shop pages could not be fetched (the /shop path returns 404 and product links are script-rendered), so no publisher price was recorded (stockists: GBP 13 at Pics & Ink and Tender Books). The site itself does not state a city; London comes from stockist descriptions ('from London, UK') and the magazine's London-restaurant cover stories. The site's own 'The Magazine' page still lists only three issues, so Issue 4's release date is inferred from stockist listings: Public Knowledge Books (hint) Dec 2025, Pics & Ink 5 Feb 2026, Papercut 13 Feb 2026; a 2025 copyright date appears on Tender Books. The 'centring people of colour' statement on the publisher's site is about editorial focus and was not read as a formal identity-tag claim (no black-led or diaspora wording about the publisher itself).
